body:
CALIBRATION COURT REREVIEW — BLOCK current frozen bytes.

Reviewed all 395 lines at SHA-256 ec6aa669568ae77bade1e0fb6609bfd96b249c2c98560a75a9d08f0bf47532f3. The nomination-provenance finding is correctly repaired as an execution precondition at lines 99-105, and the support-honesty dependency is explicit. Four scientific blockers remain:

1. ORACLE DISCOURSE LEAKAGE, lines 90 and 95. The identity records oracle/predicted origin but never bars the oracle from RecallUnit.function. The gold protocol calls discourse an oracle label at protocol line 161; DefaultLocalCostModel consumes the function in FunctionPrior and ExternalStates.natural at cost.scala:715-763. Oracle substitution therefore supplies part of the answer used to fit the floor. Freeze separate model-input and gold identities, require unattended or cross-fitted model input, and add an oracle-substitution contamination court.

2. INFERENCE HAS TWO INCOMPATIBLE GOLD MEANINGS, lines 150-176 and 229-232. WOG creates Groundedness.Inference with nonempty targets and primary at wog.scala:91-100. GoldUnit calls these acceptable anchors, and existing metrics treat any primary as source-anchored while excluding Inference from externalRule at metrics.scala:217-241 and 280-295. This court instead counts any predicted source for Inference as false-source. Separate related-source evidence targets from acceptable alignment targets, or define a distinct adjudicated binary floor target.

3. UNINTERPRETABLE DOES NOT ESTABLISH EXTERNAL ORIGIN, lines 150-176 and 229-232. Failure to interpret content does not falsify source support. Treat it as binary indeterminacy unless a separate observation establishes external origin; retain it in the roster and report its rate without turning an adjudication limit into participant error.

4. PARTICIPANT WEIGHT IS STILL MISSING, lines 136-139 and 234-250. Participants may recur across stories, but the point estimand averages family, lineage, recall, unit. A participant with several recalls receives several votes. Participant-clustered uncertainty does not change those weights, so the claim that a prolific participant cannot dominate is false. Add a participant coordinate or freeze one eligible recall per participant at the relevant level, or explicitly name the unequal-participant estimand and drop the claim.

I do not approve this digest. These are court-definition repairs; they do not request implementation or API work in this bead.
